subject: reading
title: A Farm Morning
about: A farm morning: Carl finds the corn bin empty and feeds his horse Star carrots from the garden instead. The story practises the vowel-plus-r spellings er, ar and or (morning, barn, corn, garden, carrots, perfect), two-syllable and compound words (sunrise, forgot, helpless) and the endings -ing and -less, with the Unit 4 tricky words today, yesterday, tomorrow and Monday. It is decodable at CKLA Unit 4, which the class usually reaches in January to February.
tip: When he stalls on barn, corn or her, cover the rest of the word and ask what the vowel and the r say together, then blend.

passage.text:
Today is Monday.
Carl gets up at sunrise.
He runs to the barn.
Star is his horse.
"Morning, Star!" says Carl.

Star is snorting and stomping.
Carl looks in the corn bin.
It has no corn in it!
Yesterday Carl forgot to fill it.

But Carl is not helpless.
He drags a cart to the garden.
He picks lots of carrots.
Star munches and crunches them.
Carl brushes her soft back.
Star rubs her nose on his arm.
"Tomorrow I will get corn," says Carl.
What a perfect morning!

cards.note: The second line says Carl gets up at sunrise.
Carl runs to the barn, where Star is.

cards.q: What does Star munch and crunch?
cards.note: Carl picks carrots from the garden because the corn bin is empty.

cards.q: What does Carl do first in the story?
cards.note: First Carl gets up at sunrise; the carrots and the brushing come later.

cards.q: At the end, what does Carl say he will get tomorrow?
cards.note: The last thing Carl says is that he will get corn tomorrow.

cards.q: How does Star feel when the bin has no corn?
cards.note: Snorting and stomping show Star is upset; the story does not say it in words.
The corn bin is empty, so Carl finds Star something else to munch.

cards.q: In the story, what does the word helpless mean?
cards.note: Help plus -less means without any help; Carl can help Star, so he is not helpless.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: Barn, born and bark all have a vowel plus r; only barn is in the story.
